headline: GraphSkillAA uses addressable skill graphs and two-stage gates for targeted agent-skill updates
summary: The September 2026 v2 arXiv paper introduces GraphSkillAA, which represents external skills as a graph of addressable applicability, execution and exclusion fields plus typed relations. A teacher compares successful and failed executions to propose local edits; an affected-case Local Gate and a whole-update-pool Big Gate accept or roll back changes. The authors report three-seed held-out mean hard accuracies of 81.5% on SearchQA, 66.7% on LiveMath and 91.2% on DocVQA with GPT-5.6-sol, and highest reported means across nine model–benchmark comparisons in a separate SkillOpt-protocol table. These are paper-reported results, not independently reproduced evidence; the paper limits its conclusions to the tested splits, moderate graphs and primarily single-turn tasks.
